ewpo-fit.summary: Gaussian electroweak fits from supplied measurements, cited formulas and covariance assumptions.

applicability.scope: supplied finite inputs within cited parametrization and linear-response domains

ewpo-fit.launch_contract: Pure numerical API launches no process. Upstream worker execution must use the existing admitted eft-toolchain operation. External fit execution awaits its admitted adapter.

ewpo-fit.summary: SM, indirect, conditional oblique and supplied linear SMEFT Gaussian fits.

workflow_handoff.output: Fresh caller-selected JSON path; Python consumers receive dictionaries and control their own serialization.
workflow_handoff.admission: Bind supplied sources, formulas, variants, covariances and method choice in ordinary scientific admission before upstream execution; no direct launch path is added.
workflow_handoff.scientific_scope: Numerical convergence and synthetic closure do not imply physical qualification. Oblique SM nuisance parameters are fixed at the declared reference point. Covariance is local Gaussian information; indirect intervals are profiled at the supplied delta-chi-square threshold.
source_holds: Published PDF hashes and validity domains must be supplied
Effective-angle polynomial requires a cited runtime shard
Pinned upstream angle model is a supplied constant and cannot qualify the requested polynomial

input_schema.parameter_point: Complete supplied m_Z, m_t, m_H, alpha_s and delta_alpha_had; additional formula parameters such as delta_alpha_lep are explicit.

inputs.parameters: Map of SM parameter names to value, positive uncertainty and declared units.
inputs.observables: Map of supplied observable names to value, positive uncertainty and units; m_W is excluded from this map.
inputs.m_W: One object containing variant, value and positive uncertainty; a list is refused.
inputs.reference_point: Required for oblique mode; must equal the formula reference and supplied parameter point.

conventions.ew_scheme: alpha_mZ for oblique shifts; alpha_mZ and s2w_on_shell are supplied parameters

input_schema.covariance: order plus matrix covers the exact full population and its diagonal equals the squared supplied uncertainties; indirect mode removes the selected row and column. Absence declares independent supplied marginal errors and is disclosed in the result.
input_schema.theory_covariance: Supplied PSD matrix over the same population, explicitly added as independent theory covariance; none is invented.
input_schema.free_parameters: Caller-selected subset of the five SM parameters; their full set is the default for SM and indirect fits.
input_schema.drop: One measured parameter or observable in indirect mode.
input_schema.free_u: Boolean oblique convention; false fixes U to zero and returns a rank-two three-coordinate covariance.
input_schema.parametrizations: Map of polynomial shards: sources with id, citation and locator; validity ranges tied to a source; dimensioned variables, transformations, coefficient terms and output units. Missing domains always refuse.
input_schema.linear_response: SMEFT response from supplied zero-coefficient baseline and Jacobian, explicit Warsaw basis, GeV^-2 units, scale, source domains, coefficient population and matching SM reference point.
input_schema.coefficient_priors: Supplied Gaussian coefficient constraints in GeV^-2, included in the covariance population.
